title: Mozilla Sponsors: Supporting a Better Web
description: Learn how Mozilla sponsors support the mission to build a better web, understand the privacy-focused approach to sponsorship, and discover how these partnerships benefit Oasis users.
content:
Mozilla sponsors play a crucial role in supporting the mission to build a better web. These partnerships enable Mozilla to develop and maintain open-source projects like Firefox and Firefox-based browsers such as Oasis, while maintaining a strong commitment to user privacy and web standards. Understanding how Mozilla sponsors work and their privacy-focused approach helps users appreciate the sustainable model that keeps the web open and accessible for everyone.

Pro Tip

Mozilla's sponsorship model is designed to balance financial sustainability with user privacy. Sponsors support Mozilla's mission while respecting user data and maintaining the open web principles that benefit everyone.

What Are Mozilla Sponsors?

Mozilla sponsors are organizations and companies that support Mozilla's mission to build a better web through financial contributions and partnerships. These sponsorships help fund:

Development and Innovation

Sponsors help fund ongoing development:

  • Browser Development: Firefox and Firefox-based browsers like Oasis
  • Web Standards: Development of open web standards
  • Privacy Tools: Creation of privacy-enhancing technologies
  • Open Source Projects: Maintenance of open-source codebases

Mission and Advocacy

Support for Mozilla's broader mission:

  • Digital Rights: Advocacy for internet freedom and privacy
  • Education: Web literacy and digital skills programs
  • Research: Studies on internet health and privacy
  • Community: Support for developer and user communities

How Sponsorship Works

Privacy-First Approach

Mozilla's sponsorship model prioritizes user privacy:

  • No Personal Data Sharing: Mozilla does not share personal user data with sponsors
  • Transparent Partnerships: Clear disclosure of sponsorship relationships
  • User Choice: Users can opt out of sponsored content
  • Privacy Standards: Sponsors must meet Mozilla's privacy requirements

Sponsored Content

How sponsored content appears in browsers:

  • New Tab Page: Sponsored content may appear on the new tab page
  • Search Results: Sponsored search suggestions in the address bar
  • Recommendations: Sponsored product or service recommendations
  • Educational Content: Sponsored educational materials about web topics

Revenue Model

How sponsorships support Mozilla's work:

  • Financial Support: Direct funding for development and operations
  • Infrastructure: Support for servers, bandwidth, and technical resources
  • Research Funding: Money for privacy and security research
  • Community Programs: Funding for educational and advocacy initiatives

Privacy and Data Protection

User Data Protection

How Mozilla protects user privacy in sponsorships:

  • No Personal Information: Personal data is never shared with sponsors
  • Aggregated Data Only: Only anonymous, aggregated data may be shared
  • User Consent: Clear opt-in/opt-out mechanisms for sponsored content
  • Data Minimization: Minimal data collection for sponsorship purposes

Sponsor Requirements

Privacy standards that sponsors must meet:

  • Privacy Policies: Clear, transparent privacy policies
  • Data Practices: Respectful data collection and usage practices
  • User Rights: Respect for user rights and choices
  • Security Standards: Adequate security measures for user data

Transparency Measures

How Mozilla ensures transparency:

  • Public Disclosure: Clear identification of sponsored content
  • Partnership Transparency: Open information about sponsor relationships
  • Regular Reporting: Regular updates on sponsorship activities
  • User Communication: Clear communication about sponsorship practices

Benefits for Oasis Users

Enhanced Features

How sponsorships benefit Oasis development:

  • Faster Development: More resources for feature development
  • Better Performance: Improved browser performance and optimization
  • Enhanced Security: Better security features and updates
  • Privacy Tools: Advanced privacy protection features

Sustainable Model

Long-term benefits of the sponsorship model:

  • Continued Development: Ongoing browser improvements and updates
  • Open Source Maintenance: Sustained support for open-source projects
  • Community Support: Resources for user and developer communities
  • Innovation Funding: Money for research and new technologies

Managing Sponsored Content

Opting Out

How to disable sponsored content in Oasis:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Navigate to the "Home" or "New Tab" section
  3. Find "Sponsored Content" or "Recommendations" settings
  4. Toggle off sponsored content options
  5. Save your preferences

Note: Disabling sponsored content may reduce Mozilla's ability to fund development, but it's always your choice.

Customizing Preferences

Fine-tune your sponsored content experience:

  • Content Types: Choose which types of sponsored content to see
  • Frequency: Control how often sponsored content appears
  • Categories: Select categories of sponsored content you're interested in
  • Educational Content: Opt in to sponsored educational materials

Understanding Sponsored Content

How to identify and understand sponsored content:

  • Clear Labeling: Sponsored content is clearly marked as such
  • Transparency: Information about why content is being shown
  • User Control: Easy ways to provide feedback or opt out
  • Educational Value: Focus on content that provides value to users

Mozilla's Mission and Values

Building a Better Web

Mozilla's core mission and how sponsors support it:

  • Open Web Standards: Development and promotion of open web technologies
  • User Privacy: Protection of user privacy and data rights
  • Digital Inclusion: Making the web accessible to everyone
  • Innovation: Fostering innovation in web technologies
  • Education: Promoting web literacy and digital skills

Values and Principles

Core values that guide Mozilla's sponsorship approach:

  • Transparency: Open and honest about partnerships and practices
  • User Control: Users have control over their experience
  • Privacy First: Privacy considerations come before profit
  • Open Source: Commitment to open-source development
  • Community: Support for user and developer communities

Sustainable Development

How sponsorships enable sustainable development:

  • Long-term Planning: Ability to plan and execute long-term projects
  • Resource Allocation: Proper funding for development priorities
  • Innovation Investment: Money for research and experimental features
  • Community Support: Resources for community programs and events

Types of Sponsors

Technology Companies

Tech companies that support Mozilla's mission:

  • Search Engines: Search providers that support open web standards
  • Cloud Services: Cloud providers that respect user privacy
  • Security Companies: Companies focused on cybersecurity and privacy
  • Open Source Projects: Other open-source organizations

Educational Institutions

Academic and educational sponsors:

  • Universities: Research institutions studying internet health
  • Educational Organizations: Groups promoting digital literacy
  • Research Programs: Programs studying privacy and security
  • Student Programs: Support for student developers and researchers

Non-Profit Organizations

Non-profit partners supporting the mission:

  • Digital Rights Groups: Organizations advocating for internet freedom
  • Privacy Organizations: Groups focused on privacy protection
  • Open Source Foundations: Foundations supporting open-source development
  • Community Organizations: Local and global community groups

Impact and Success Stories

Development Achievements

How sponsorships have enabled key developments:

  • Privacy Features: Enhanced privacy protection in browsers
  • Performance Improvements: Faster and more efficient browsing
  • Security Enhancements: Better protection against threats
  • Accessibility Features: Improved accessibility for all users

Community Impact

Benefits for the broader community:

  • Developer Tools: Better tools for web developers
  • Educational Resources: More resources for learning web technologies
  • Research Funding: Support for important internet research
  • Advocacy Programs: Stronger voice for digital rights

User Benefits

Direct benefits for browser users:

  • Better Browsers: Improved browser features and performance
  • Privacy Protection: Enhanced privacy and security features
  • Open Standards: Better support for open web standards
  • Innovation: Access to cutting-edge web technologies

Getting Involved

Supporting Mozilla's Mission

Ways to support Mozilla's work:

  • Use Mozilla Products: Use Firefox, Oasis, and other Mozilla products
  • Contribute to Development: Help develop open-source projects
  • Spread Awareness: Educate others about privacy and open web
  • Participate in Community: Join Mozilla's user and developer communities

Privacy Advocacy

Supporting privacy and digital rights:

  • Learn About Privacy: Educate yourself about online privacy
  • Use Privacy Tools: Use privacy-enhancing browser features
  • Support Privacy Organizations: Support groups advocating for privacy
  • Share Knowledge: Help others understand privacy issues

Open Source Contribution

Contributing to open-source development:

  • Code Contributions: Contribute code to Mozilla projects
  • Bug Reporting: Report bugs and issues you encounter
  • Documentation: Help improve documentation and guides
  • Testing: Test new features and provide feedback

Additional Resources

For more information about Mozilla sponsors and privacy, we recommend:

Mozilla Sponsor Privacy Guide - Official guide from Mozilla

About Mozilla - Learn more about Mozilla's mission and values

Mozilla Privacy Policy - Detailed privacy information

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Mozilla's sponsorship model and how it supports the development of Firefox-based browsers like Oasis. The sponsorship practices and privacy protections described are specific to Mozilla's approach. Other organizations may have different sponsorship models and privacy practices.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it benefits from Mozilla's sponsorship model and can access the resources and development support that Mozilla sponsors provide.
